description: Ownership manifest for the single-source skill layer. Skills listed in generated_skills are authored once in skills-src/<skill>/SKILL.src.md (plus optional verbatim support files under skills-src/<skill>/files/) and regenerated into both provider packages by scripts/Build-ProviderSkillPackages.ps1. Every skill not listed in generated_skills is provider-owned; the generator must not touch it.
notes: provider_owned_shared_skills exist in both provider packages but have substantively drifted; they stay provider-owned until a later reconciliation pass migrates them into skills-src.
